title: Bounded Queue with Backpressure Policies
signature: class BoundedQueue: __init__(self, loop, capacity, policy), put(item) [generator], get() [generator], dropped, rejected, max_depth, __len__
hints: Keep three FIFOs: the items, the consumers waiting for an item (futures), and the producers blocked on a full queue (future, item) pairs.
put first checks for a waiting consumer and hands the item straight to it with loop.resolve(fut, item). Only then does capacity matter.
get pops the oldest item, and if a producer is blocked, moves that producer's item into the freed slot and resolves its future. Forgetting this wakeup deadlocks the producers.
Both methods must be generators (contain a yield) but must not yield on the fast path; only yield a future when you really wait.
